sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PROGRESSIVE SPLIT-FLOW WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE LWR 48 THROUGH TUE WITHIN LARGER-SCALE CYCLONIC PATTERN ENCOMPASSING MUCH OF NORTH AMERICA. POTENT NRN STREAM IMPULSE NOW OVER THE PACIFIC NW SHOULD FURTHER AMPLIFY AS IT CONTINUES SE INTO WY LATER TODAY...AND ACROSS THE CNTRL HI PLNS EARLY TUE. THIS SHOULD MAINTAIN THE STEADY EWD PROGRESS OF SRN BRANCH TROUGH NOW OVER THE LWR MS VLY/NW GULF OF MEXICO TODAY...AND ACCELERATE THE SYSTEM ENE TO THE S ATLANTIC CST TNGT AS THE TROUGH ASSUMES A MORE NEUTRAL TILT. AT LWR LVLS...WEAK SFC CYCLOGENESIS SHOULD CONTINUE THROUGH THIS AFTN OVER THE ERN GULF OF MEXICO IN RESPONSE TO APPROACHING UPR TROUGH. SFC DEVELOPMENT...HOWEVER...WILL BE SOMEWHAT STYMIED BY OUTFLOW FROM PERSISTENT PRE-COLD FRONTAL SQLN OVER THE ERN GULF. MORE SIGNIFICANT DEEPENING LIKELY WILL NOT OCCUR UNTIL TNGT/EARLY TUE AS INCREASING ASCENT/DCVA OVERSPREAD THE GULF STREAM WATERS OFF THE NE FL CST. THE MAIN FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SVR TSTMS THIS PERIOD WILL BE OVER CNTRL AND SRN FL...WHERE INCREASING ASCENT/SHEAR AND RICHLY-MOIST ENVIRONMENT SHOULD SUPPORT CONTINUED REDEVELOPMENT/EWD PROGRESSION OF ERN GULF SQLN. OTHER...MORE ISOLD/DIURNAL STORMS MAY FORM AHEAD OF UPR SYSTEM AMPLI

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN FL TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: ERN GULF SQLN SHOULD CONTINUE STEADILY ESE INTO FL LATER TODAY/TNGT...ULTIMATELY AFFECTING MOST OF CNTRL AND S CNTRL PORTIONS OF THE PENINSULA BETWEEN NOW AND 12Z TUE. WHILE THE STRONGEST NEW UPDRAFTS HAVE BEEN FORMING ON THE SRN EXTENT OF THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM OVER THE LAST 12-18 HOURS...ONSET OF DIURNAL HEATING AND THE ASSUMPTION OF A DAYTIME BOUNDARY LAYER STRUCTURE SUGGEST THAT NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT ALSO MAY OCCUR ALONG THAT PART OF THE SQLN THAT WILL CROSS CNTRL FL LATER TODAY. MID-LVL LAPSE RATES WILL REMAIN MODEST...AND SFC HEATING SOMEWHAT LIMITED BY ANVIL CLOUDS. BUT COMBINATION OF RICH MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.75 INCHES/ AMIDST AMPLE /40+ KT/ AND SLOWLY-INCREASING WSWLY DEEP SHEAR WILL BE CONDUCIVE TO THE FORMATION OF EMBEDDED LOW-AMPLITUDE LEWPS/BOWS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND...AND POSSIBLY TORNADOES. THE LATTER THREAT SHOULD BE GREATEST LATE THIS AFTN THROUGH LATE TNGT AS DEEP SHEAR MORE APPRECIABLY STRENGTHENS /700 MB FLOW INCREASING TO AOA 50 KTS/ WITH THE CONTINUED EWD MOTION OF WRN GULF UPR TROUGH...AND BEFORE SFC DEEPENING OFF THE NE FL CST VEERS LOW-LVL FLOW. GIVEN WEAKLY-CAPPED/MOIST ENVIRONMENT...A CONDITIONAL RISK ALSO WILL EXIST FOR THE DEVELOPMENT A FEW STORMS/S

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLNS/SD THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SUBSTANTIAL SFC CYCLOGENESIS WILL OCCUR OVER ERN WY/WRN NEB LATER TODAY AHEAD OF AMPLIFYING PACIFIC NW TROUGH...WITH SETUP LIKELY TO MAINTAIN/FURTHER STEEPEN APPRECIABLE MID-LVL STATIC INSTABILITY ALREADY PRESENT OVER THE REGION. MOISTURE WILL BE SCANT AND SFC HEATING SOMEWHAT MUTED BY CLOUDS. BUT COMBINATION OF SUBSTANTIAL DEEP ASCENT WITH INCREASING CONVERGENCE SHOULD SUPPORT SCTD AFTN/EVE STORMS. FAIRLY DEEP...WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER ENVIRONMENT MAY YIELD GUSTY OUTFLOW WINDS. ..CORFIDI/THOMPSON.. 03/17/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...INCLUDING TORNADOES...IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE THIS MORNING. THIS MAY NECESSITATE THE ISSUANCE OF A TORNADO WATCH DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CORRIDOR OF DEEP CONVECTION HAS PERSISTED THROUGH MUCH OF THE NIGHT OVER THE EAST GULF/LOOP CURRENT INVOF A NE/SW-ORIENTED LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE AXIS WITHIN A WARM CONVEYOR IMPLIED BY OVERNIGHT MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY. SFC ANALYSIS REVEALS A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT ROUGHLY ALIGNING WITH THIS ACTIVITY THAT EXTENDS FROM BROAD LOW PRESSURE IN THE MIDDLE GULF TO NRN FL. THETA-E DEFICITS OWING TO PERSISTENT CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING ROUGHLY N OF A LINE FROM CITRUS TO FLAGLER/VOLUSIA COUNTIES ARE REINFORCING THIS BOUNDARY. S OF THE BOUNDARY...POSITIVE MOISTURE ADVECTION IS SUPPORTING AN INFLUX OF MIDDLE-UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS AMIDST SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW LAYERS PER 12Z TBW...MFL...AND KEY RAOBS. SLIGHTLY HIGHER DEWPOINTS LIE ALONG THE W FL COAST NEAR AND S OF TAMPA WHERE SOME ONSHORE FLOW COMPONENT OFF THE E GULF IS BREEDING AN INLAND MANIFESTATION OF LATENT HEAT FLUXES ATOP THE WARMER GULF WATERS. TBW VWP DATA INDICATE 50-65 KT OF SWLY/WSWLY FLOW IN THE 4-7-KM-AGL LAYER -- I.E. POSSESSING SOME /ALBEIT LIMITED/ COMPONENT ORTHOGONAL TO THE AMALGAMATION OF E-GULF MESO-BETA-SCALE CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS. THIS WILL CONTINUE TO FOSTER A GRADUAL NET EWD MOTION OF THE STRONGER CONVECTION TOWARD THE W FL COAST THROUGH THE MORNING. MEANWHILE...MODEST DIURNAL SFC-LAYER HEATING BENEATH THE MID/HIGH-LEVEL CLOUD CANOPY...SHED DOWNSTREAM OF ONGOING CONVECTION...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO CONTINUED DESTABILIZATION TO THE S OF THE AFOREMENTIONED SFC BOUNDARY. ALREADY...THE 12Z TBW RAOB INDICATES AROUND 1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE WITH NEGLIGIBLE MLCINH. THE JUXTAPOSITION OF THE PREVIOUSLY MENTIONED STRONG MID-LEVEL FLOW WITH A 35 KT LLJ SAMPLED BY THE TBW AND MLB VWP/S AND THE 12Z TBW RAOB WILL MAINTAIN THE POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTION. CONVECTIVE MODE WILL LIKELY CONSIST OF QUASI-LINEAR SEGMENTS WITH EMB

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THE TORNADO WATCH. HOWEVER...STRONGEST CONVECTION REMAINS OFFSHORE AND MAY REMAIN OVER THE ERN GULF FOR SEVERAL HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SW-NE ORIENTED PRE-FRONTAL SQUALL LINE CONTINUES ITS SLOW EWD PROGRESSION ACROSS THE ERN GULF BASIN WITH NERN LINE SEGMENT WEAKENING AS IT SPREADS INLAND. WHILE INDIVIDUAL CELLS ARE TRANSLATING NEWD ALONG THE LINE AT FAIRLY QUICK SPEEDS...THE OVERALL EWD MOVEMENT IS ROUGHLY 15KT. LATEST SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS STRONGEST/DEEPEST ASCENT LAGS THIS LINE OF CONVECTION AND SHOULD NOT APPROACH THE PENINSULA UNTIL AFTER DARK. BOUNDARY LAYER AIR MASS IS WARMING SIGNIFICANTLY SOUTH OF THE PRECIP SHIELD WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE LOWER-MID 80S. RESULTANT LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE STEEPENED WITH SFC-3KM VALUES GREATER THAN 8 C/KM. EVEN SO THE ONLY MEANINGFUL BOUNDARY LAYER CU FIELD IS ACROSS THE SERN TIP OF THE PENINSULA AND IT/S NOT APPARENT DISCRETE UPDRAFTS WILL EVOLVE AHEAD OF AFOREMENTIONED ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE. OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS SUGGEST STRONGEST CONVECTION MAY NOT MOVE/DEVELOP INLAND UNTIL UPPER SUPPORT ARRIVES LATER THIS EVENING. ..DARROW.. 03/17/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL THROUGH THE EVENING REMAINS A BIT UNCLEAR. WHILE IT APPEARS GENERALLY LOW IN THE NEAR TERM...POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT COULD STILL INCREASE BY LATE EVENING...PARTICULARLY ALONG EAST CENTRAL ATLANTIC COAST AREAS NEAR/NORTH OF MELBOURNE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITH CONSIDERABLE WEAKENING OF AN INITIAL LINE OF THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY...THE EASTWARD ADVANCEMENT OF ITS ASSOCIATED OUTFLOW LIKELY IS STALLING. IT CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM EAST CENTRAL COASTAL AREAS TO THE NORTH OF MELBOURNE...SOUTHWESTWARD ACROSS THE INTERIOR CENTRAL PENINSULA INTO GULF COASTAL AREAS TO THE NORTHWEST OF FORT MYERS. MODELS CONTINUE TO INDICATE THAT A SIGNIFICANT UPSTREAM SHORT WAVE IMPULSE WILL TAKE ON AN INCREASING NEUTRAL TO NEGATIVE TILT AS IT PROGRESSES EASTWARD ACROSS THE EASTERN GULF COAST AND NORTHEASTERN GULF OF MEXICO THIS EVENING. THIS IS EXPECTED TO BE ACCOMPANIED BY SUBSTANTIAL STRENGTHENING OF DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW FIELDS AND VERTICAL SHEAR...INCLUDING THE INTENSIFICATION OF A SOUTHERLY 850 MB JET TO 50+ KT WITHIN A CORRIDOR ALONG THE STALLED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY BY THE 03-06Z TIME FRAME. CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY REMAINS CONCERNING THE EXTENT OF THE CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL THIS EVENING ACROSS THE PENINSULA...WITH RELATIVELY WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES LIMITING CAPE ALONG THE AFOREMENTIONED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHERE A CORRIDOR OF PRECIPITABLE WATER APPROACHING 2 INCHES APPEARS TO EXIST. HOWEVER...IT SEEMS THAT THE BOUNDARY INTERSECTION NEAR/NORTH OF MELBOURNE...WHERE CONSIDERABLE MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES A DEEPENING SURFACE LOW BY 06Z...COULD PROVIDE THE PRIMARY LOW-LEVEL FOCUS AND FORCING FOR NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS EVENING. IF STORMS DO DEVELOP...HODOGRAPHS ARE EXPECTED TO BE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING TORNADOES. ..KERR.. 03/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN...BUT PROBABILITIES FOR SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE AT LEAST SOMEWHAT DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT A NEW WATCH WILL BE NEEDED...BUT TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID/UPPER FLOW IS STRONG ACROSS MUCH OF THE PENINSULA AND WILL CONTINUE TO STRENGTHEN THROUGH THE 06-09Z TIME FRAME...AS MODELS SUGGEST A 90-100+ KT 500 MB SPEED MAXIMUM IS BEGINNING TO NOSE INLAND FROM THE NORTHEASTERN GULF OF MEXICO. VWP DATA FROM MELBOURNE INDICATE THAT LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS HAVE COINCIDENTALLY BECOME QUITE LARGE AND CLOCKWISE CURVED...WITH INTENSIFICATION OF SOUTHERLY FLOW AROUND 850 MB...AHEAD OF A SURFACE LOW APPROACHING THE WEST CENTRAL GULF COAST. BEFORE NEW SURFACE LOW DEVELOPMENT COMMENCES OFF THE EAST CENTRAL ATLANTIC COAST LATER TONIGHT...A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY STILL APPEARS TO EXIST FOR VIGOROUS NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN THE VERTICAL SHEAR...THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES APPEAR AT LEAST MARGINALLY SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING TORNADOES. AND IT DOES NOT APPEAR OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT THIS THREAT COULD INCREASE WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO NEAR REMNANT INTERSECTING SURFACE BOUNDARIES AROUND THE MELBOURNE AREA. GUIDANCE IS SUGGESTIVE THAT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS THEN POSSIBLE SOUTHWARD THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF INTERIOR CENTRAL/SOUTHERN FLORIDA OVERNIGHT...AHEAD OF AN INLAND ADVANCING COLD FRONT.
